artifact_class: NOT-A-GRADED-RUN — gamora KP-225 v3.11 oracle pass 4 (the referent's own line-up + the six mutators; seed 9 = V310-FULL, declared secondary). Nothing tuned; every configuration named in the math note before it ran.

fire_range.operating_limb: gd_use_range_m_HI (radii x scale); LO in the file, unused
fire_range.halt_distance: UNCHANGED 2.4 m (D_ENGAGE_M) — GD's stop rule not established; math note § 2.2

emergence.acquisition_latency_s: DECODED: first FindEnemyUpdate scan on the 0.2 s grid from construction (KP-212 fold 3a)
emergence.cc_and_hit_reactions: VACUOUS: the oracle has no player->monster CC or monster hit-reaction mechanism (math note § 3)
emergence.pets: VACUOUS: no p05 record carries a pet contract

composition.rule: row = base * max(0, a + P/100) (GD Game.dll; legolas Leg 2, grade A)
composition.reduced_damage_debuffs: MAX rule satisfied: one reduction applied (War Cry), none summed

sp.rule: next swing at max(animation, U{min..max} ms), rerolled per swing (Game.dll IV, grade A; legolas R4; star-lord sp2)
sp.auras: not swing-gated (an aura is not a swing)
sp.pack: V4-ANTI-1 retired by star-lord v3.9 corrigendum sp3

c11b.basis: C-11b B monsterAttributePak Ultimate/1p +10% dex+int (DB-SOURCED-EXACT); A = charLevel equation, C-11b mean x1.010 (DECLARED)

init.rule: initial = one self-cast at Startup End (UseInitialSkillIfSet 0x0feb90; legolas lead 6; star-lord dc1): non-aura initial removed from the attack set; gr3 aura initial -> toggled aura at its GD radius; roster only (pets untouched, declared)

eng.rule: pursue to CloseEnoughToUseSkill(chosen); stand in Attack (Idle); re-choose after each skill; specials -> Normal -> Default melee; 2.4 m halt retired for roster (legolas lead 1, DATAMINED A; port of tools/arms_extra.py p_ai + p_default_attack)
stand_ins: pets keep the incumbent movement and selection (Default slot + pause only)

hunt.rule: nearest live body; only while the 3.0 m disc is empty (start-of-tick); player + K-MILL anchor translate at v_close; re-read every tick; live = alive and spawned

pilot_move.rule: P-MOVE (§ 6.4 addendum): state-conditioned block replay of the referent's own windows (speed, heading offset from the nearest live body); supersedes drive + P-HUNT drift + K-MILL + I-4 apply

lineup.law: pinned alternative; n ~ U{max(lo,k)..hi}, emitted min(n, cap); pins first; remainder uniform over the alternative minus FOOTAGE absences; per-salt line-up RNG

mutators.index_law: the body's own ThreatProfile.level, 1-based (INFERRED); clamped to 102-109
